info.title: TLITODOS Backend API
info.description: FastAPI endpoint server for the TLITODOS shared todo-list app. This OpenAPI document is written for frontend and AI-agent consumption: field names match the JSON API contract, authenticated operations use BearerAuth, and upload endpoints explicitly document multipart/form-data.

tags.name: authorization
tags.description: Google login, current user profile, notifications, and Discord linking

tags.name: categories
tags.description: Per-user todo categories. A user can create up to 5 categories.

tags.name: todos
tags.description: Todo CRUD, subtasks, dependencies, and todo-scoped bet creation

tags.name: bets
tags.description: Bet status, proof upload, and verification

tags.name: diaries
tags.description: Diary entries with optional image uploads

tags.name: notifications
tags.description: Notification list, kind filter, paging, and read state

post.summary: Log in with Google access token
post.description: Validates a Google access token, creates or updates the user, stores an API access token and refresh token, and returns the TLITODOS token pair.
Rotates a valid refresh token and returns a new access token plus a new refresh token. The submitted refresh token is revoked.
Revokes the submitted refresh token when it exists and is not already revoked.

patch.description: Accepts either JSON fields or multipart/form-data. Multipart uses field name image and returns profileImageUrl as /uploads/profiles/{filename}.

post.description: Exchanges a Discord OAuth authorization code for user information and stores the linked Discord username.

get.description: Friend todo completions, friend diaries and bet requests, newest first. Cursor-paged.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Return only this kind. Omit for every kind.

patch.description: Stores the font key the client renders the app with. Unknown keys are rejected.

200.description: Groups the current user belongs to.

delete.description: Only the group leader can delete a group.

patch.description: Group leader only. Only the name can be changed.

get.description: Returns only the invite code for a group the current user belongs to.

delete.description: Only a LEADER can remove another member. The leader cannot remove themselves through this endpoint.

post.description: Group leader only. Removes every listed member in one request.
The group leader cannot leave; delete the group instead.

get.description: Returns the current user's categories by default. To view another member's categories, provide both userId and a groupId shared by the requester and that member.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: Shared group id. Required with userId when viewing another member's categories.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Category owner user id. Omit to view the current user's categories.

200.description: Categories owned by the requested user.
Category updated. isDeletable is not included in this endpoint response.

delete.description: Non-deletable default categories, such as 취미, cannot be deleted.

get.description: Returns the current user's todos by default. Any logged-in user can read another user's todos: pass userId, and pass groupId as well on a group screen so the requester and that member are checked to share the group. Todos no longer carry a visibility, so nothing is filtered out by visibility. Editing, completing and deleting stay owner-only.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Returns every todo whose startDate..dueDate range covers this date, both ends included.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Todo owner user id. Omit to view the current user's todos. On a group screen send groupId too so shared membership is checked.

get.description: One entry per day of the month, for the calendar's dots and per-day counts. Pass userId (and groupId on a group screen) to summarise another member's month; the requester and that member must share the group. A todo spanning several days is counted on every day it covers.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Todo owner user id. Omit to summarise the current user's month.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: Group shared by the requester and userId.

200.description: Daily statuses for every day of the month.

get.description: Returns one todo. Any logged-in user can read it; only the owner can change it.

delete.description: Deletes the todo. For a routine occurrence this deletes the entire routine, including completed occurrences, so warn the user before calling it.

patch.description: A todo can be completed only when all subtasks are completed.
Clears the completed flag and completedAt.

post.description: Adds dependencyTodoId to the todo dependencies array. Todos in category id 1 cannot be linked as dependencies.

put.description: Replaces the whole dependency list. An empty array clears it. Cycles are rejected.

post.description: One request creates the routine and every occurrence in a single transaction. Do not loop a POST per date.

201.description: Routine created, or the stored result of an identical retry.

410.description: The routine for this requestId was deleted. Do not recreate it with the same key.

get.description: Returns the immutable rule the routine was created from. Current occurrence state comes from the todo endpoints.

delete.summary: Delete a routine and every occurrence
delete.description: Deletes all occurrences including completed ones and the original todo, plus dependency references, bets and notifications attached to them. Calling it again succeeds with deletedCount 0.

post.summary: Turn a todo into a routine
post.description: Moves the original todo to the first occurrence date and creates only the later dates. Title and category come from the original. A todo already in a routine is a 409; another user's todo is a 404.

201.description: Routine created, or the stored result of an identical retry.

410.description: The routine for this requestId was deleted. Do not recreate it with the same key.

get.description: Bets the current user requested or is the subject of.

patch.description: When approved is true, the bet status becomes VERIFIED.

get.description: Returns the current user's diaries by default. Pass userId (and groupId) to read a fellow group member's PUBLIC diaries.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Diary author user id. Omit to read the current user's diaries.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: Group shared by the requester and userId.

post.description: Accepts either JSON or multipart/form-data. Multipart image uploads return imageUrl as /uploads/diaries/{filename}.

get.description: Requires Authorization: Bearer. An cannot send the header, so fetch the bytes and render an object URL.
Requires Authorization: Bearer. Only the author and, for PUBLIC diaries, fellow group members may read it.

get.summary: Get an uploaded bet proof image
get.description: Requires Authorization: Bearer. Only the parties to the bet may read it.

BearerAuth.description: Use the accessToken returned by POST /api/v1/auth/google as Authorization: Bearer {accessToken}.

UnauthorizedError.description: Missing, expired, or invalid bearer token.

isCompleted.description: True when every todo of that category on that date is completed.

incompleteCount.description: Number of that date's todos that are not completed.

categoryStatuses.description: Only categories that have a todo on that date.

date.description: Local calendar date the diary belongs to, as YYYY-MM-DD.

imageUrl.description: Static upload path such as /uploads/diaries/{filename}, or null.

createdAt.description: ISO-like datetime string generated by the backend.

date.description: Local calendar date the diary belongs to. Defaults to today when omitted.
Local calendar date the diary belongs to. Defaults to today when omitted.
Local calendar date the diary belongs to. Omit to leave it unchanged.

googleAccessToken.description: Google OAuth access token from the frontend login flow.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token returned by login or token refresh. Send this in the request body, not in the Authorization header.
Opaque token used with POST /api/v1/auth/refresh and POST /api/v1/auth/logout.

expiresAt.description: UTC datetime string without timezone suffix, generated by the backend.

refreshToken.description: New opaque refresh token. The refresh token submitted in the request has been revoked.

expiresAt.description: Access token expiration as a UTC datetime string without timezone suffix.

refreshExpiresAt.description: Refresh token expiration as a UTC datetime string without timezone suffix.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as cursor. null on the last page.

description.description: Detail text. An empty string when the todo has none.

startDate.description: First day of the todo, as YYYY-MM-DD.

dueDate.description: Last day of the todo, inclusive. The todo appears on every date from startDate through dueDate.

time.description: HH:MM in five-minute steps, or null when no time is set.

timezone.description: IANA time zone. Defaults to Asia/Seoul.

routineId.description: Owning routine id. Older rows may have isRoutine=true with routineId=null; those are not grouped or bulk-deleted.

createdAt.description: ISO-like datetime string generated by the backend.

TodoPreview.description: Todo summary embedded in a notification.

startDate.description: Defaults to the creation date when omitted.

dueDate.description: Inclusive last day. Defaults to startDate when omitted.

dependencyTodoIds.description: Replaces the whole dependency list. An empty array clears it.

interval.description: WEEKLY only: 1 is every week, 2 every other week. Other frequencies accept 1.

weekdays.description: WEEKLY only: Monday=1 through Sunday=7. Duplicates are removed and the list sorted. Omit to use the start date's weekday.

Recurrence.description: MONTHLY keeps the start date's day of month and skips months without it; YEARLY keeps the month and day. Missing dates are never moved to the end of the month.

requestId.description: One UUID per create action. A retry must reuse the same key and the same body; a new key creates another routine.

endDate.description: Inclusive. The range spans at most 36,600 days and must produce 1 to 1,000 occurrences.

weekdays.description: Compatibility field for older clients. Sending it together with recurrence is a 422.
Compatibility field for older clients. Sending it together with recurrence is a 422.

RoutineScheduleRequest.description: Turns an existing todo into a routine. Title and category come from the original todo.

createdCount.description: Total occurrences, counting the reused original todo when converting.

definition.description: The immutable normalised request that created the routine. Later edits to individual occurrences do not change it.

deletedCount.description: 0 when the routine was already deleted.

Visibility.description: Diary visibility only. PUBLIC is visible to fellow group members, PRIVATE only to the author, and GROUP (partial visibility) is on hold so it behaves like PRIVATE. Todos no longer carry a visibility.

x-ai-agent-notes: Most endpoints except /ping, /api/v1/auth/google, /api/v1/auth/refresh, and /api/v1/auth/logout require Authorization: Bearer {accessToken}.
POST /api/v1/auth/google returns accessToken and refreshToken. Use accessToken in the Authorization header, and use refreshToken only in the JSON body of refresh/logout requests.
The backend uses camelCase JSON field names in request/response bodies even though many Python model attributes are snake_case.
Upload URLs are relative static paths served from /uploads.
GET /api/v1/groups/{groupId}/invite-code returns only groupId and inviteCode for lightweight invite-code display.
The backend currently stores dueDate, createdAt, completedAt, expiresAt, refreshExpiresAt, and diary createdAt as strings rather than strict date-time schema values.
PATCH /api/v1/users/me and POST /api/v1/diaries accept multiple content types; choose multipart/form-data only when uploading an image.
Todos no longer have a visibility. Any logged-in user can read another user's todos; editing, completing and deleting stay owner-only. Diary visibility is separate and unchanged.

A todo spans startDate..dueDate with both ends included, so GET /api/v1/todos?date= and GET /api/v1/todos/daily-status both report it on every day in the range. One completion state is shared across the range; routine occurrences complete independently.
TodoCreateRequest and TodoPatchRequest are additionalProperties: false. Sending the removed groupId, visibility or isRoutine keys is a 422.

Routines are created with a single POST /api/v1/todos/routines (or POST /api/v1/todos/{todoId}/routine). Do not loop one POST per date. Keep the requestId and the exact body for retries: a new UUID creates a second routine, a changed body is a 409, and a deleted routine's key is a 410.
Deleting a routine occurrence with DELETE /api/v1/todos/{todoId} deletes the whole routine, completed occurrences included. Warn the user first.
GET /api/v1/todos/daily-status accepts userId and groupId, so a group member's whole month can be marked on the calendar.
PATCH /api/v1/groups/{groupId} renames a group (leader only). POST /api/v1/groups/{groupId}/members/remove removes several members at once.
Signing up no longer creates a personal group, so GET /api/v1/groups can be an empty array. Todos and routines only need a categoryId from GET /api/v1/categories.
Files under /uploads require Authorization: Bearer. Fetch the bytes with the token and render an object URL instead of putting the path in an .
